NDT software in Baytown: built for resident crews at very large sites

NDT software for Baytown companies has a specific job: keep resident crews, turnaround surges and pipeline work at a few very large sites organised without drowning in paperwork. The Atlantis ERP solution gives Baytown inspection companies one system for technician certifications, instrument calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quotes and invoices, configured around the way you already work for your clients.

Baytown's industrial base is dominated by a small number of very large complexes. The ExxonMobil Baytown complex, which includes a refinery, a chemical plant and an olefins plant, is one of the largest integrated sites in the United States. Chevron Phillips Chemical operates its Cedar Bayou plant on the east side of town, and Covestro runs a large chemical site in Baytown. A few miles north-east, Mont Belvieu is one of the main natural gas liquids storage and fractionation hubs in North America, with salt-dome caverns, fractionators and a dense web of pipelines. Cedar Port Industrial Park adds large logistics and industrial tenants along the bay.

That shapes the typical Baytown NDT contractor. Many hold long-term resident contracts inside one plant, with a crew that badges in every day and works a steady flow of inspection requests, then scales up hard when a unit comes down. OSHA process safety management drives the mechanical integrity work, TCEQ monitors emissions events, and PHMSA rules apply to the pipelines leaving the Mont Belvieu area. Turnaround peaks fall in spring and fall, and hurricane season from June through November can move them at short notice.

ERP for NDT companies in Baytown: one record per unit, crew and job

An ERP for NDT companies in Baytown should let you run a resident contract like a business, not a timesheet factory. The Atlantis ERP ties each technician, instrument, job and invoice to the same database, so you can see what a unit or cost centre is costing and earning.

Resident contracts inside a large complex create a particular problem. Work arrives as a steady stream of small requests from different units and different client inspectors, each with its own work order number. At month end, someone has to match hundreds of timesheet lines to the right PO and cost centre. When that is done in spreadsheets, hours get lost and client reps dispute invoices.

In the Atlantis ERP, each request can be set up as a project task carrying method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, procedure and WPS references. Timesheets record work type, method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, and they go through approval. Invoices then carry the job or PO number, site and cost centre on every line. See the full list of apps at Atlantis ERP apps.

Technician certification tracking for Baytown resident crews and turnaround surges

Technician certification tracking software for Baytown needs to cope with two very different situations: a stable resident crew whose certs expire on a rolling basis, and a turnaround surge where dozens of techs arrive in a week. The Certificates app handles both.

Each certification records scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam passed and attachments. Status is calculated as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked. Warning tasks appear 90 days before a cert or vision test expires, and email alerts can be sent to the resident supervisor as well as the office.

For resident crews, the risk is complacency. A PT Level II who has been inside the same plant for three years is easy to forget about until the client's QA auditor asks for the eye exam. Vision tests are tracked with near vision at Jaeger J1 or J2, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner and clinic. For turnaround surges, the risk is speed: examination sheets with general, specific and practical scores, and certificate templates per scheme with required vision test, exam and minimum OJT and training hours, let your Level III confirm quickly that a new hire meets your written practice.

Crew dispatch and utilisation for Baytown's large complexes

Crew dispatch software for Baytown has to show who is committed to the resident contract, who is on a turnaround, and who can be released to other work. The Team Assignments app runs jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The availability calendar blocks overlapping assignments, leave, training, sickness and unavailable days. Technicians and instrument serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and an out-of-calibration instrument triggers a warning. Each technician shows utilisation, current assignment and next available date.

Utilisation matters in Baytown because resident crews are often under-used between surges and over-stretched during them. With utilisation visible, you can send spare capacity from a resident crew to a short pipeline job near Mont Belvieu, or bring in extra techs before an olefins unit outage instead of during it. Time Off feeds the availability calendar, so approved leave shows up before the dispatcher assigns the crew. The project record carries safety induction and work permit fields, useful when different units inside the same complex have different entry rules.

NDT reporting software for olefins, heat exchangers and alloy piping

NDT reporting software in Baytown has to handle the methods that large chemical and olefins plants use most. The NDT Reports app covers 17 report types, including ECT and IRIS for heat exchanger tubes, PMI for alloy verification, hardness and PWHT for weld repairs, UT thickness readings by direction, and PAUT and TOFD for weld examinations.

Olefins and chemical plants run a lot of heat exchangers, and a single turnaround can mean bundle after bundle of tube inspection. Each report type has its own numbering sequence, so ECT and IRIS reports stay in order. PMI and hardness reports matter where alloy piping and repair welds need verification. Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation, and each report ends with an overall result of acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports go through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and the client's third-party or authorized inspector name and signature. References to work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard are captured on each report. Large Baytown clients usually specify their own formats, so versioned company templates are set up in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, with Excel templates filled automatically by field-to-cell mapping. Techs use the offline field app inside the plant and sync later.

Calibration management software for Baytown instrument pools

Calibration management software is the difference between passing and failing a plant audit. In the Asset Management app, every eddy current instrument, IRIS system, PMI analyser, hardness tester, flaw detector and probe is tracked by serial number with condition, assigned person, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited lab flag, pass, fail or conditional result and next due date. The calibration certificate register stores the lab accreditation number and PDF, with valid, expiring or expired status and alerts. The Purchase app classifies vendors as OEM, dealer or calibration lab, with accreditation number and expiry, and order lines can link to a specific equipment serial, so the cost of each calibration is tied to the instrument.

Resident crews in Baytown tend to keep instruments on site for long periods. The issue and return workflow, with supervisor and manager approval and condition recorded both ways, makes it clear which gauge is in the plant, which is back at the shop and which is overdue. The maintenance log records preventive work, repairs, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacements with condition before and after.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Baytown contracts

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Baytown has to handle both a long-term resident contract and one-off turnaround packages. The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with services flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded quotation PDF that the client can accept and sign online.

The Invoicing app is built around NDT billing. Headers carry the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector. Lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Timesheets with billable flags and rate multipliers feed billing directly, so standby, travel and overtime are not left off.

Where a Baytown client wants monthly invoices split by unit or cost centre, cost centres keep each line in the right bucket. A custom invoice layout is built during implementation to match what the client's accounts payable team expects. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months.

Inspection management software in Baytown: procedures, audits and NCRs

Inspection management software for Baytown companies must stand up to audits from large operators with their own QA teams. The Procedures app holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the procedure text or file.

Procedures go through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejection reasons and archive, and approved revisions are locked. Full revision history with a snapshot of each revision makes it easy to show the auditor which revision a crew used on a given date. An AI-assisted first draft helps a Level III write a new procedure faster, and the Level III still reviews and approves it.

NCR and CAPA workflows can be configured during implementation, so a client audit finding at the complex becomes a tracked action with an owner and due date. Dashboards show certs expiring or expired, calibrations due or overdue and issued equipment overdue for return, which is the first page an auditor usually wants to see.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Baytown: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Baytown should fit around your resident contract, not force you to change how your client works. Atlantis NDT is led by an ASNT NDT Level III, so implementation starts from NDT operations.

  1. Map the contract: units, cost centres, PO structure and report formats your Baytown client requires.
  2. Load the people: technicians, certifications, vision tests and training hours from your current records.
  3. Load the instruments: serial numbers, calibration certificates, due dates and consumables.
  4. Build templates: client report formats, quotation and invoice layouts.
  5. Connect systems: the open REST API can integrate with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.
  6. Train and go live: preferably between turnaround peaks.

Pricing is a quote on request, sized to your crew and apps. Book a Baytown NDT ERP demo and we will walk through it with your contract structure.

Frequently asked questions

Is there NDT software suited to resident contracts in Baytown?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP tracks each request as a project task, logs timesheets with method, site and equipment serial, and invoices by PO and cost centre, which suits resident contracts inside large complexes.

Can it produce heat exchanger ECT and IRIS reports?

Yes. ECT and IRIS are two of the 17 built-in report types, each with its own numbering sequence and approval workflow.

How does it warn us about expiring certifications?

Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, and configurable email alerts go to the people you choose.

Is it affordable for a small NDT company in Baytown?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP is positioned as affordable, accessible and fully customizable. Pricing is a quote on request based on your size and the apps you need.

The open REST API can connect to SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections. The scope is agreed during implementation.

Yes. Contact us for a demo using your own methods and report formats.
